maddeler.e:
اعلوليا (form XII)
# اِعْلَوْلَيَا (iʕlawlayā) /iʕ.law.la.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# اُعْلُولِيَا (uʕlūliyā) /uʕ.luː.li.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# اِعْلَوْلِيَا (iʕlawliyā) /iʕ.law.li.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
